Right on Time

The prophecy mystery and time mystery share a similar kinship as other mysteries that share feats, and given their shared themes, GMs might consider allowing prophecy mystery and time mystery to share feat selections that are normally restricted to the other.

Cursed by Choice

New level 1 class feats gives each oracle mystery more identity, but it also introduces a large number of level 1 choices for players. Since oracles typically only get a level 1 class feat from their mystery, this might not affect most tables but GMs might consider limiting some level 1 class feats to specific mysteries to cut down on choice paralysis.

New Oracle Mysteries.name: New Oracle Mysteries
New Oracle Mysteries.text:
Mysteries are questions, and questions are meant to be answered. Oracles of all walks are tasked with answering their own unique question with only their curse as a clue to where they might find their answer. Oracles are defined by the highs and lows of their mysteries, an endless oscillating spectrum through which they engage the world. Being chosen as an oracle can result from any number of acts of divine providence, but finding the answer to one’s own mystery often has but a single, ultimate, and seemingly unattainable answer.

Apocryphal Domain Spells.name: Apocryphal Domain Spells
Apocryphal Domain Spells.text:
Of all divine casters, oracles are perhaps the most likely to uncover unusual aspects of a domain. Included here are new apocryphal domain spells for domains that did not previously have any. These domains were chosen in order to ensure every mystery has access to at least one domain with an apocryphal spell. While oracles may find use in these spells, they are also usable by champions, clerics, and any other casters who can access domain spells.
